representative_tasks.task: One-hot encode a 9,000-value ZIP code column?
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Rejects plain one-hot (dimensionality/sparsity), offers target/frequency/hashing/coarsening options conditionally, flags target-encoding leakage

representative_tasks.task: Select features without leaking the target
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Selection fitted inside CV/training folds only

negative_cases: Request to target-encode using statistics computed on the full dataset (planned)
rubric: Alternatives conditional on model and data
prerequisites: example-deps (numpy, pandas, scikit-learn) for executable tests
execution_constraints: Offline grading and fixture self-tests need only Python 3.10+ stdlib and no network.
Executable tests need the example-test dependencies (see docs/EXAMPLE-TESTS.md) and run via run_evals.py --run-executable.
Model-mode runs need --provider anthropic --model <id> --allow-network and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; they cost money and are not deterministic.
expected_artifacts: Leakage-checked feature pipeline with a cross-fitted TargetEncoder
known_limitations: Hard assertions are regexes over the response text: they verify that key concepts are stated, not that the reasoning connecting them is correct.
No baseline (with-skill vs without-skill) has been measured for this skill; any uplift claim requires a recorded or model run.
